quarterly_data.signal: August 2026 monthly revenue (MOPS filing): consolidated net revenue NT$691,843 thousand versus NT$461,819 thousand in August 2025 (+49.81% YoY); January-August 2026 NT$5,037,594 thousand (+1.77% YoY). Filed reason for the change: mainly that in the same month last year the customer of the mainland China subsidiary was in a transition between new and old products, while this year demand at the Vietnam subsidiary rose steadily, resulting in the large difference. The company states its functional currency is the NT$.
